title: Best Places to Visit in Narkanda, Complete Travel Guide from Shimla & Beyond
content:
Narkanda - Himachal Pradesh,

Narkanda, a serene hill town in Himachal Pradesh, is nestled in the Shimla district at an altitude of approximately 2,700 meters above sea level. Just 65 km from Shimla, this quaint town is a hidden gem that offers a perfect blend of natural beauty, adventure, and tranquility. Unlike more crowded hill stations, Narkanda is calm and peaceful, making it an ideal destination for travelers seeking to escape the hustle of city life. With its snow-covered slopes in winter, lush green forests in summer, and vibrant apple orchards, Narkanda has something for everyone.

The town is famous for Hatu Peak, the highest point nearby, which offers breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding Himalayan ranges. Adventure enthusiasts can indulge in skiing and snowboarding during the winter months, while summer brings perfect conditions for trekking, nature walks, and exploring scenic trails lined with pine and deodar trees. Narkanda’s charm is further enhanced by its traditional Himachali culture, friendly locals, and the simplicity of life in this mountain town.

Apple orchards are scattered throughout the region, and visiting them during the harvest season provides an unforgettable experience of picking fresh, juicy apples while enjoying the crisp mountain air. Narkanda is also a favorite spot for photographers, as the landscape changes with each season—snow-laden slopes in winter, blooming orchards in spring, and lush green valleys in monsoon.

Whether you are a family looking for a peaceful getaway, a couple on a romantic retreat, or a solo traveler seeking adventure and relaxation, Narkanda caters to all. Its proximity to Shimla makes it convenient for day trips, yet it is quiet enough for a longer stay. With its combination of natural beauty, adventure activities, and serene atmosphere, Narkanda is truly a year-round destination that promises memorable experiences for every traveler.

How to Reach Narkanda:

  • By Road: 65 km from Shimla via National Highway 5. Taxis and buses are available.
  • From Shimla Railway Station: Approx. 2 - 3 hours by road.
  • By Air: Nearest airport is Jubbarhatti Airport, Shimla (around 80 km).

Best Time to Visit Narkanda:

  • Peak Season (December - February): Perfect for skiing, snowboarding, and snowfall photography.
  • Moderate Season (March - June): Pleasant weather for sightseeing, treks, and apple orchard visits.
  • Low Season (July - September): Monsoon brings lush greenery but occasional road closures.

Distances from Key Cities:

  • Shimla to Narkanda: 65 km (approx. 2 - 3 hrs by road),
  • Delhi to Narkanda: 407 km (8 - 9 hrs by road),
  • Chandigarh to Narkanda: 180 km (4 - 5 hrs by road),
  • Kalka to Narkanda: 163 km (6 - 7 hrs by road),
  • Manali to Narkanda: 327 km (approx. 9 - 10 hrs by road),

Things to Do in Narkanda:

  • Hatu Peak : The highest point in Narkanda, ideal for trekking and panoramic photography.
  • Hatu Mata Temple : Ancient temple at Hatu Peak with unique wooden architecture.
  • Skiing & Snowboarding : Popular in winter; slopes suitable for beginners and experts.
  • Apple Orchards & Stokes Farm : Pick fresh apples and explore lush orchards.
  • Tanni Jubbar Lake : Serene lake surrounded by pine forests, perfect for picnics.
  • Mahamaya Temple : A peaceful temple dedicated to Goddess Mahamaya, especially vibrant during Navratri.
  • Trekking Trails & Nature Walks : Explore scenic trails lined with deodar and pine trees.
